questions.question: Evaluate ∫₀^2 xsqrt(4 - x^2) dx using substitution u = 4 - x^2

points.text: u = 4 - x^2, du = -2x dx -> x dx = -½ du. Limits: x=0->u=4, x=2->u=0. ∫₄⁰ sqrtu (-½)du = ½∫₀⁴ u^½ du = ½[⅔u^⅔]₀⁴ = ⅓(8) = 8/3
